lines.text: After ten years in Canaan, childless Sarai gave her Egyptian maidservant Hagar to Abram to be his wife.
Hagar conceived and began to despise Sarai, so Sarai treated her harshly and Hagar fled.
The angel of the LORD found Hagar by a spring on the road to Egypt and told her to return.
The angel promised countless offspring and told her to name her son Ishmael, because the LORD had seen her joy.
Hagar called the LORD the God who sees me, and the well lay between Kadesh and Bered.
